summary: Live Camera Streaming Widget feature verified end-to-end. 18/18 backend camera-stream tests pass; UI renders camera widget beside DO tanks with correct telemetry overlay, admin-only Configure dialog, and non-admin users correctly hidden from the Configure button.

issues: Radix Dialog console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' — non-functional accessibility warning; wrap the tagline in <DialogDescription> or pass aria-describedby to silence.

action_items: (Optional a11y polish) Wrap the 'Device: <hw>' hint in the CameraConfigDialog inside a <DialogDescription> component (or pass aria-describedby) to fix the Radix DialogContent console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: api_camera.py is well-scoped (~190 lines) with clear helpers _detect_type / _youtube_id / _embed_url. Regex handles youtube.com/shorts/, /watch?v=, /embed/, /live/, /v/ and youtu.be/. Falls back to substring match for edge cases. MongoDB _id correctly stripped via _serialize.
POST is upsert-on-hardware_id (unique index enforced in server.py line 217). Send twice for the same device -> single doc updated. Verified in test_upsert_on_same_hardware_id.
GET /by-device/{hw} correctly returns null (not 404) when no camera configured, so the UI branch 'No camera configured' renders. Non-owner client -> 403 verified.
PUT re-detects stream_type when stream_url is supplied but stream_type omitted (line 168-169). DELETE returns 404 idempotently.

api_water_quality.latest_readings() correctly enriches with registered-but-unreported devices (placeholder entries) — verified DO_TEST_001 seeded readings + new placeholder do_meter both appear in the response.

LiveCameraWidget.jsx: 16:9 aspect ratio locked with inline style, telemetry overlay uses tabular-nums + font-mono for stable digit width, embed URL from backend has autoplay/mute/loop/playlist params so YT Shorts loops seamlessly. iframe has 'allow=autoplay; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture' which lets YT autoplay muted (browsers allow muted autoplay).
WaterQuality.jsx correctly gates canManage={isAdmin} — verified in UI test (admin sees Configure btn, client does not).
Overlay data-testids overlay-do-tank-1 / overlay-do-tank-2 / overlay-timestamp all present and populated with the latest DO values (5.42 / 6.18 mg/L for DO_TEST_001).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (widget render, overlay values, iframe embed, admin Configure dialog, client no-Configure — all verified)
